posts.title: Coffee Woke Civilization
posts.description: How a tiny seed changed the way we work, think, meet, and start the day Bread gave civilization calories. Beans gave it protein. Olive oil gave it light. Coffee gave civilization somewhere to meet—and a reason to stay awake. Coffee came late to Western civilization. The Greeks didn’t have it. The Romans didn’t have it....
